scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d --wait postgres rabbitmq redis typesense embedder mailpit otel-collector tempo prometheus loki grafana floci gateway-dev && docker compose run --rm postgres-roles && docker compose run --rm floci-init && node --env-file=.env tools/migrate-all.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:infra && nx run-many -t dev --all
scripts.local:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.aws-like.yml stop gateway-dev && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.aws-like.yml up -d --build --wait && node --env-file=.env tools/migrate-all.mjs
scripts.local:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.aws-like.yml stop gateway identity-service catalog-service search-service inventory-service sales-service payment-service chatbot-service ops-console-service operations-query-service customer-web staff-web && docker compose up -d --wait gateway-dev
scripts.load: docker compose --profile loadtest run --rm k6 run --out experimental-prometheus-rw
scripts.diagrams:export: node tools/likec4.mjs export png -o docs/diagrams/png docs/diagrams
